summary: E2E testing of the new 'Editar datos del huésped' feature (VERA OS Alquileres). Backend PATCH /api/rentals/reservations/{rid}/huesped verified with 4 pytest tests (all PASS). Frontend verified end-to-end via Playwright: row 'Editar datos' button opens modal pre-filled correctly, partial updates persist with correct merge semantics (untouched fields preserved), and the nested 'Editar datos del huésped' button inside Confirmar reserva opens an overlapping modal that live-updates the Confirmar summary (nombre + huéspedes) without closing the parent Confirmar modal. All regression buttons on the row (Confirmar, Rechazar, WhatsApp, Comprobantes) remain visible/clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: HuespedBody.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) correctly handles partial updates; empty body is a safe no-op (verified).

EditarHuesped.tsx form sends ALL 8 fields on save (always-set), not only edited ones. Backend still merges correctly, but if a field is cleared in the UI it will overwrite the stored value with '' (expected behavior per spec: user is editing manually). Not a bug, just a note.
No auth / tenant check on PATCH /huesped endpoint - consistent with other rental routes (open API acknowledged as backlog).
